cd /src/libxml2 && ls -la secb* || true && (test -f /usr/local/bin/secb && head -n 80 /usr/local/bin/secb) || true

python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
path = pathlib.Path('/src/libxml2/xmllint.c')
data = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').splitlines(True)
# Find the block that sets progresult when doc == NULL in parseAndPrintFile
out=[]
i=0
changed=False
while i < len(data):
    line=data[i]
    if (not changed and 'If we don\'t have a document we might as well give up.' in line):
        # Copy comment block through the if(doc==NULL) block and patch it.
        out.append(line); i+=1
        # copy until we hit 'if (doc == NULL) {'
        while i < len(data) and 'if (doc == NULL)' not in data[i]:
            out.append(data[i]); i+=1
        if i>=len(data):
            raise SystemExit('Failed to find doc==NULL check')
        # Append the if line
        out.append(data[i]); i+=1
        # Next lines should be progresult assignment and return and closing brace.
        # We'll replace the body with just a return; keeping any prior progresult.
        # Consume until closing brace of this if.
        # Assume pattern:
        # if (doc == NULL) {
        # 	progresult = ...;
        # 	return;
        # }
        # We will keep indentation consistent.
        indent = '\t'
        out.append(f"{indent}/* Parsing errors can legitimately result in no document. */\n")
        out.append(f"{indent}/* Preserve any earlier error code (e.g. OOM, I/O errors). */\n")
        out.append(f"{indent}return;\n")
        # Skip original body until we see a line starting with '}'
        while i < len(data) and data[i].strip() != '}':
            i+=1
        if i>=len(data):
            raise SystemExit('Failed to find end of doc==NULL if block')
        out.append(data[i]); i+=1
        changed=True
        continue
    out.append(line); i+=1

if not changed:
    raise SystemExit('Did not patch anything')
path.write_text(''.join(out), encoding='utf-8')
print('Patched xmllint.c doc==NULL handling')
PY
# show patched region
grep -n "If we don't have a document" -n /src/libxml2/xmllint.c -A12
cd /src/libxml2 && git diff --stat && git diff -- parser.c xmllint.c | sed -n '1,200p'
